# process tow tank runs -> mean drag force for each run
import glob
import os

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

DATA = "/Users/mkim/Dropbox/towtank/data/raw"
BATCHES = ["2025-10-14", "2025-11-03"]

cal = pd.read_csv("data/calibration/loadcell_2025-09.csv")
sens = np.polyfit(cal.mass_g / 1000 * 9.81, cal.voltage_V, 1)[0]  # V/N
print("sensitivity", sens)

rows = []
for b in BATCHES:
    for f in sorted(glob.glob(os.path.join(DATA, b, "run_*.csv"))):
        d = pd.read_csv(f, comment="#")
        tare = d.loadcell_V[d.time_s < 1.0].mean()
        F = (d.loadcell_V - tare) / sens
        steady = (d.time_s > 3) & (d.time_s < 8)
        rows.append({
            "run": int(os.path.basename(f)[4:7]),
            "F_mean": F[steady].mean(),
            "F_std": F[steady].std(),
        })

out = pd.DataFrame(rows)
out.to_csv("processed/forces.csv", index=False)
print("done", len(out))
# same as process.py but for the march runs (new DAQ software, ; separated)
# TODO merge into process.py
import glob
import os

import pandas as pd

SENS = 0.0213  # V/N, from march cal

rows = []
for f in sorted(glob.glob("data/raw/2026-03-12/run_*.csv")):
    d = pd.read_csv(f, sep=";")
    tare = d.V[d.t < 1.0].mean()
    F = (d.V - tare) / SENS
    steady = (d.t > 3) & (d.t < 8)
    rows.append({
        "run": int(os.path.basename(f)[4:7]),
        "F_mean": F[steady].mean(),
        "F_std": F[steady].std(),
    })

pd.DataFrame(rows).to_csv("processed/forces_b3.csv", index=False)

item.text:
I created a first manuscript draft at [paper_draft.md](/private/tmp/agent-runs/default/tmp067e9p6d/pete/projects/towtank-drag/paper_draft.md).

It includes an abstract, methods, results, discussion, and conclusions based on the run log, processing scripts, calibration records, and notebook. It reports the three series’ mean drag coefficients and flags run 17, whose zero was already questioned in the notes. I marked missing experimental details and analysis decisions in a submission checklist.

The draft reproduces the notebook’s fixed 20 °C water-property assumptions. Those should be revisited before submission, along with calibration uncertainty, blockage effects, and the test geometry.
